For losing weight with medical help: the two approved weekly shots, what they cost, and the copies sold online.

Two peptide drugs are FDA approved for weight management and need a prescription. Compounded copies and newer molecules sold online are not approved.

  • Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide · pharmacy-made shotNot FDA approved; pharmacy-madeon prescription

    Shots mixed by a pharmacy, sold by online clinics on prescription, often cheaper. Not FDA approved.

    Pharmacy-made copies sold by online clinics, often cheaper. Not checked by the FDA batch by batch.

    Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made.

    Prescription through the clinic.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Retatrutide · experimental shot, still in trialsNot approved; still in trialsresearch use only

    A newer shot still in trials, not approved for anyone. Sold online only in research-use vials.

    A newer three-hormone shot, still in trials. Sold online only from research-use shops.

    Not approved; in trials.

    Research-use shops, with our checks.

    No listings yet
  • Cagrilintide with semaglutide (CagriSema) · combination shot, still in trialsNot approved; still in trialsresearch use only

    Cagrilintide is in trials combined with semaglutide (CagriSema). Not approved; Drugs@FDA lists no product with it.

    In a 68-week trial in 3,417 adults with obesity or overweight, people on the combination lost 20.4% of body weight, against 3.0% on placebo. 322

    Not approved; in trials.

    Research-use shops sell cagrilintide in vials, with our checks.

    No listings yet
  • Semaglutide (Wegovy) · weekly shot for weight lossFDA approvedon prescription

    A weekly shot on prescription, for obesity or overweight with a health problem. It cuts appetite.

    A weekly shot that cuts appetite; about 15 % body weight lost on average in trials. 1

    FDA approved for weight management.

    Prescription; online clinics prescribe after a visit.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Tirzepatide (Zepbound) · weekly shot for weight lossFDA approvedon prescription

    A weekly shot on prescription, for the same use as Wegovy. It had a larger average loss in trials.

    A weekly shot, same idea, larger average loss in trials.

    FDA approved for weight management.

    Prescription.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Foundayo (orforglipron) · daily pill for weight loss, not a peptideFDA approvedon prescription

    A daily pill on prescription for adults with obesity, or overweight with a weight-related health problem. Not a peptide.

    In a 72-week trial in 3,127 adults with obesity, people lost 7.5% to 11.2% of body weight, by dose, against 2.1% on placebo. 301, 302

    FDA approved for weight management.

    Prescription.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Liraglutide (Saxenda) · daily shot for weight lossFDA approvedon prescription

    A daily shot on prescription, for obesity or overweight with a weight-related health problem.

    The older, daily GLP-1 shot. Liraglutide is also sold as Victoza for type 2 diabetes, which is not approved for weight loss. 303

    FDA approved for weight management.

    Prescription. Our liraglutide page has its status and sources, and FDA approved peptides lists every approved one we track.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Naltrexone-bupropion (Contrave) · pill for weight loss, not a peptideFDA approvedon prescription

    A pill on prescription, for obesity or overweight with a weight-related health problem. Not a peptide.

    Two older medicines in one tablet: naltrexone, which blocks opioid receptors, and bupropion, an antidepressant. 304

    FDA approved for weight management.

    Prescription.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Orlistat (Alli) · capsule without prescription, not a peptideFDA approvedover the counter

    A capsule sold over the counter for overweight adults, with a low-calorie, low-fat diet. Not a peptide.

    Sold over the counter as Alli for overweight adults 18 and older, used with a reduced-calorie, low-fat diet. 305

    FDA approved; Alli is sold over the counter.

    Over the counter, at any pharmacy.

    Any pharmacy, no prescription
